description: The Institute of Chartered Accountants of Sri Lanka -  Sri Lanka Auditing Standards Changes effective for the Financial Periods ending on or after 15.12.2019
categorisation: This gazette content involves the publication of updated Sri Lanka Auditing Standards under the Sri Lanka Accounting and Auditing Standards Act, No. 15 of 1995. It contains regulatory changes to auditing standards, including technical definitions, amendments to existing standards, and implementation timelines. This falls under Legal/Regulatory classification as it deals with regulatory frameworks, compliance requirements, and statutory instruments governing accounting and auditing practices.
